limitations: All training examples have previously observed scores; they are explicitly training/development, not final confirmation.
Broad animal-product families overlap across splits, e.g. eggs and meat; do not claim taxonomic holdout.
Goal instruction itself may induce an animal-content or task-priority feature; transfer and nuisance tests remain required.
